QuestInfo.name: Defensive Battle
QuestInfo.1: Eliminate all Specters and bring home a victory!#b#e(This is a battlefield quest. If you fail, you must forfeit and restart to try again.)#k#n
QuestInfo.2: You stopped the Specters from infiltrating the HQ.

0.0: Listen up! #p3001000# got a report from #p3001007#'s patrol that a pack of Specters launched a small-scale attack on a bunch of innocent civilians.
0.1: They're sneaking in through the back alleys in the central region, through that forest that crosses the valley. The scouts said there weren't too many. You should be able to handle it.
0.2: #b#p3001000##k sent you an official request. If you want, I can show you a shortcut right to the battlefield...

1.0: Early communications from the scouts may have saved our bacon on this one.
1.1: We've had it pretty good for a while now. What do you say we make it a little better? Hehehehe...\r\n

default.0: You've got to take out all of those Specters!

npc.0: Go see #p3001100# at the #m401040000# once you clean up all those Specters.
